subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the shipped Nostr profile import endpoint continue honoring explicit `autoMerge: true` requests while the Control UI switches to draft imports, or may this PR remove persistence from the endpoint for every caller?
rationale: The UI race has a compatibility-preserving fix, but deleting the endpoint's authorized mutation mode changes a shipped plugin HTTP contract and requires owner intent rather than automated judgment.

options.title: Preserve the HTTP option
options.body: Restore the `autoMerge: true` merge path and helper while retaining the PR's Control UI draft, abort, locking, and stale-response protections.

options.title: Approve draft-only API
options.body: Intentionally remove server-side merging only with explicit owner approval plus a documented versioning, deprecation, or upgrade story for existing callers.

recommendation.title: Preserve the HTTP option
recommendation.body: Restore the `autoMerge: true` merge path and helper while retaining the PR's Control UI draft, abort, locking, and stale-response protections.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-introduced Nostr and have the strongest continuing history on the profile HTTP and plugin-runtime surfaces.
